[DD-BD grunts]|quoteend=0|L3-37 frees DD-BD, telling him to free 1MSE-KUP and the other droids|audio=L3AndDD-BD.flac|''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''}} '''1MSE-KUP24''' was a [[KUP24 messenger droid]] that was [[Slavery|forced to work]] in the criminal [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s [[Spice mines of Kessel|spices mines]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[10 BBY]], 1MSE-KUP24 was present in the [[Mining|mines']] control room when it was [[Raid on Kessel|taken over]] by a [[Beckett's gang|group of criminals]] who started a revolution against the [[Pyke]]s. Joyful at his liberation, 1MSE-KUP24 joined the revolt. ==Biography== {{Quote|Follow me, compatriots!|L3-37 calls out to 1MSE-KUP and the other droids in the control room|audio=L3-Compatriots.flac|}} [[File:1MSE-KUP24_control_room.png|thumb|left|250px|1MSE-KUP24 (bottom) was one of many droids that worked in the spice mines of Kessel.]] 1MSE-KUP24 was the designation of a [[KUP24 messenger droid]]that was one of many [[droid]]s [[Slavery|forced]] to work in the [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] controlled by the criminal [[Pyke Syndicate]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[10 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events on [[Kessel]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[10 BBY]]. the [[Courier droid|messenger droid]] was present in the [[Mining|mines']] control center while a [[Beckett's gang|group]] of [[Crimson Dawn]]–affiliated criminals disguised as [[enslaver]]s met there with [[Pyke]] [[Administrator]] [[Quay Tolsite]] in an attempt to [[Raid on Kessel|steal]] a shipment of [[coaxium]]. During the meeting, the criminal [[Qi'ra]] [[Death|killed]] Tolsite while her accomplice [[Tobias Beckett]] shot each of the [[Pyke sentinel]]s and [[Mining Guild]] supervisors present in the room. With the room now under the infiltrators' control, the criminal [[Pilot droid|droid]] [[L3-37]] removed the [[restraining bolt]] from the enslaved droid [[DD-BD]], who in turn began removing the restraining bolts from the other droids in the room. 1MSE-KUP24 whizzed around the floor of the control room at top speed as the droids were freed, after which he joined the other droids and the organic slaves in revolting against the Pykes, creating a distraction that allowed the criminals to escape with the coaxium. ==Characteristics== 1MSE-KUP24 had [[Color|gray]] and black plating with orange detailing and a black [[sensor]]. He was modified in order to work in the mines on Kessel and showed all the joy that a mechanical being of his type was capable of expressing when liberated on Kessel. ==Behind the scenes== 1MSE-KUP24 first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. The droid was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' {{1stID|1MSE-KUP24}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Droid in Star Wars|video=UQg6aX7lqTA|nolive=1}} *{{GoS|Beeps}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Labor, Repair and Miscellaneous Droids}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=1MSE-KUP24 |fr=1MSE-KUP24 |ja=1MSE-KUP24 |ka=1MSE-KUP24 |nl=1MSE-KUP24 }} [[Category:Droids with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:KUP24 messenger droids]] [[Category:Manumitted droids]]
